craft_notes: Sthāyin: bhakti-vīra of fixing; vyabhicāri bhakti-utsāha at one-pointed heart-ground. Sanskrit-first: citrācitra (VARIED-UNVARIED — unexplained per UNC, kept); ekāgra (ONE-POINTED — kept). Rows: 9 (varied/unvaried/beyond-difference triple — power's manner kept whole), 1 (‘there’ closes — still ground last). Close: ‘may my heart-ground fix one-pointed there’. Rupture: colon (power walks, then heart prays — doctrine turns to prayer). Rejected: explaining stations — killed: unexplained (recorded); ‘undivided’ smoothing — killed: varied-unvaried-beyond kept three. Read aloud: HENCE-his-POW-er-WALKS — VAR-ied, un-VAR-ied, be-YOND-diff-er-ence — EV-er … SO on-THIS-still-GROUND, BHAI-ra-va, YOUR-step — MAY-my-HEART-ground FIX one-POINT-ed THERE.

lines: Hence His power walks — varied, unvaried, beyond difference — ever,
never parting, nohow: so on this still ground, Bhairava, Your step — may my heart-ground fix one-pointed there.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vibhoḥ śaktiḥ śaśvad vrajati na vibhedaṃ katham api | tadekāgrībhūyān mama hṛdayabhūr bhairava vibho
